settings.aiDesc: Providers are used in order per purpose and switch to the next candidate on failure. Keys are given as a file path or typed directly.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholder: API key (not needed if a file path is set)
settings.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: API key (saved; leave blank to keep it)
settings.duplicateId: IDs cannot be empty or duplicated
settings.excludeAppsDesc: Skipped while in the foreground (partial app-name match).
settings.excludeHint: Temporarily stops screen recording (nothing is captured).
settings.languageDesc: Switches the UI language (the tray menu follows).
settings.liveSummaryIntervalDesc: How often screen activity is summarized.
settings.minIntervalDesc: Lower bound for exact on-screen text capture.
settings.outputLanguageDesc: Generated text (summaries, daily reports) is written in this language.
settings.routeAddPlaceholder: + Add a provider for this purpose
settings.routeNotSet: Not set (features using it are disabled)
settings.syncSendDesc: Records are queued locally and sent in batches; recording continues while the server is unreachable.
settings.thresholdDesc: Higher = only big screen changes are recorded.
settings.updateAutoCheckDesc: Checks GitHub releases at startup and every 6 hours. Windows downloads in the background and updates on restart; macOS shows a notice with a button to open the download page.
settings.getStartedSub: Start by setting up an AI provider

sm.desc: The AI reads your screen and turns it into work records. Records go to the sync server and power the timeline and daily reports. Password managers and similar apps can be excluded in settings.
sm.outsideHours: Outside the recording hours. Recording resumes automatically in the next window.
sm.permissionHint: Turn on screen recording permission so the AI can record your work from the screen.
sm.recordingDesc: Summarizes activity every 30s and transcribes text when the screen changes.
sm.selectSource: Select at least one screen or window
sm.startDisabledHint: Pick a screen or window to record in "Recording targets".
sm.startHint: When recording starts, the AI reads screen changes and keeps them as work records.
sm.targetsDisabledHint: Settings can be changed after stopping recording.
sm.title: Screen recording
